hero.h1: Where real businesses find new owners.
hero.subHeadlineRest: Not startups, not crypto. We give your business the presentation it needs to find the right buyer.

problem.quote: I know every corner of this business. I just don't know where to start when it comes to selling it.
problem.response1: The businesses Bottega lists aren't speculative.
problem.response2: They have cash flow, they're proven, and they're founder-run.
problem.response3: Their challenge isn't viability: it's transition.
problem.brokersQuote: "I spend more time explaining the business than selling it."
problem.buyersQuote: "Half the listings I look at don't have enough information to take a first step."

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.step1Body: Answer ten questions about your sector, size, and deal terms. Takes about ten minutes. You can stay anonymous — your name and company won't appear publicly until you choose.
howItWorks.step2Body: Every listing is human-written and reviewed before going live. No AI copy, no templates — a structured page that gives buyers what they actually need to make a decision.
howItWorks.step3Body: Buyers in Italy and Portugal find your listing and request an introduction under NDA. You decide who sees the financials. No cold calls, no unsolicited enquiries.

why.heading: Built for businesses that don't need a pitch deck.
why.body1: Most deal platforms are designed for startups: high-growth companies raising money, burning cash, betting on a future. Bottega is built for the opposite: businesses with cash flow, real clients, and years behind them.
why.body2: These businesses don't need hype. They need a clear presentation: financials framed properly, story told well, so the right buyer can recognise what they're looking at. That's what Bottega does.
why.proof1Label: The only platform focused on these two markets
why.proof2Label: We curate and review every deal page, not an algorithm
why.proof3Label: Financials and sensitive info protected until you decide to share

pricing.label: Plans
pricing.plan1PriceNote: No listing fees. No broker commission.
pricing.plan1Desc: You complete the seller form and we review, write, and publish your deal page. Buyers find you through Ownly's directory. You handle introductions directly.
pricing.plan1Feature2: Listed in the Italy & Portugal deal directory
pricing.plan2Desc: We work with you to complete the seller form, sharpen the deal narrative, and identify which buyers are most likely to see value in your business.
pricing.plan2Feature2: 1:1 onboarding call to complete the form together
pricing.plan2Feature3: We identify likely buyers and help you lead with the right message
pricing.plan2Feature4: Inquiry qualification — we pre-screen buyer interest on your behalf

buyer.heading: If you're looking at Italy or Portugal, you're already ahead of most.
buyer.body1: Institutional capital hasn't found this market yet. The businesses are real, the prices are rational, and the sellers are motivated. Most buyers who reach out to us have already tried brokers — and found the process slow, opaque, and expensive.
buyer.body2: We're building the infrastructure that makes acquiring here easier. If you're serious about this market, we'd like to talk.

footerCta.heading: Your business deserves a proper presentation. Start here.

step4.title: Your story
step4.subtitle: Help buyers understand what makes this business worth looking at.

reasons.label: Why are you considering a sale?

description.label: Describe your business in your own words
description.placeholder: e.g. We run a 20-year-old manufacturing business in Tuscany making custom metal parts for mid-size machinery companies. About 60% of revenue is repeat orders from 8 long-standing clients.
description.helper: What you do, who your clients are, what makes it work.

strongestPoint.label: What's the strongest thing about this business?
strongestPoint.placeholder: e.g. We have a 12-year exclusive supply agreement with our largest client, which accounts for 40% of revenue.
strongestPoint.helper: What would you tell a serious buyer in 30 seconds?

buyerDisclosure.label: Anything a buyer should know upfront?
buyerDisclosure.placeholder: e.g. The current owner is involved in day-to-day operations and a transition period of 6–12 months would be needed.
buyerDisclosure.helper: Risks, dependencies, or anything better disclosed early. Buyers appreciate honesty.
